meta.title: Sahaay AI — Find the welfare schemes you qualify for
meta.description: Answer a few simple questions or describe your situation. Sahaay AI finds the government schemes you are eligible for, explains why, and tells you exactly what to do next.

common.tagline: The right scheme. The right guidance. For you.
common.offline: You are offline. Your saved answers and checklist still work.
common.installBody: Add it to your home screen and open it like an app.

landing.heroTitle: Find the government schemes you deserve
landing.heroSubtitle: For students, farmers, workers, women, business owners and senior citizens. Answer a few questions or describe your situation — we show what you can get, why, and what to do next.
landing.ctaNote: Takes about 2 minutes. Your answers stay private.
landing.step1Body: Answer simple questions, or just type or speak your situation in your own words.
landing.step2Body: We check every rule and show clearly why you match or not.
landing.step3Body: Know which documents to get, where to get them, and your deadlines.
landing.featuresTitle: Built to help you, not confuse you
landing.featureMatchBody: See which rules you meet and what is still missing. No guessing.
landing.featureDocsBody: Learn what each certificate is, who issues it, and where to get it.
landing.featureDeadlineBody: Sign in to get notified when a new scheme matches you.
landing.featureLanguageBody: Use Sahaay AI in English, Kannada or Hindi — type or speak.
landing.featureTrustBody: Every scheme shows its official source and when it was last checked.
landing.featureAssistantBody: Ask questions in your own words and get simple answers.
landing.statsLabel: Central government schemes for every state and union territory, plus state schemes — for students, farmers, workers, women, entrepreneurs and senior citizens.
landing.exampleNext: Next step: get your income certificate
landing.ctaBandBody: No sign-up. No documents needed to start.

safety.title: Stay safe
safety.disclaimer: Sahaay AI is a guidance tool, not a government service. The final decision is made by the department that runs the scheme.
safety.noPayment: Applying for government schemes is free. Never pay anyone or share your OTP.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.body: Sorry, this page could not load. Please try again.
errors.notFoundBody: We could not find this page. It may have moved.

wizard.chooseOne: Please choose one answer to continue.
wizard.ageError: Please enter an age between 0 and 120.
wizard.privacy: Your answers are saved only on this device.

occupation.title: What do you do?
occupation.help: Choose what fits you best. This helps us find the right schemes.

gender.title: What is your gender?
gender.help: Some schemes are only for women.

state.title: Which state or union territory do you live in?
state.help: Central schemes are for everyone in India. State schemes are only for people who live in that state.

areaType.title: Do you live in a village or in a town/city?
areaType.help: Some housing schemes are only for towns and cities.

category.title: Which category do you belong to?
category.help: As written on your caste certificate. Choose "I don't know" if you are not sure.

kaBackwardClass.title: Which Backward Class category are you in, in Karnataka's list?
kaBackwardClass.help: Written on your Karnataka caste certificate. Choose "I don't know" if you are not sure.

incomeBand.title: What is your family's total income per year?
incomeBand.help: Add up the income of everyone in your household. A close estimate is fine.

educationLevel.title: What are you studying now?
educationLevel.help: Choose the course you are in this academic year.

parentFarmer.title: Is your parent a farmer who owns land?
parentFarmer.help: Some scholarships are only for children of farmers.

class12Above80Percentile.title: Was your Class 12 result in the top 20% of your board?
class12Above80Percentile.help: This is called the 80th percentile. Your board's result list can tell you.

inGovernmentHostel.title: Are you staying in a government hostel this year?
inGovernmentHostel.help: Some help is only for students who did not get a hostel seat.

ownsFarmland.title: Does your family own farmland?
ownsFarmland.help: Land in your name or a family member's name in the land records (RTC).

businessStage.title: Is your business new or already running?
businessStage.help: Some loans are only for starting a new business.

ownIncomeUpTo15kMonth.title: Is your own monthly income ₹15,000 or less?
ownIncomeUpTo15kMonth.help: Count only what you earn yourself, not your family.

coveredByEpfEsiNps.title: Is PF, ESI or government NPS deducted from your pay?
coveredByEpfEsiNps.help: If your employer cuts PF (EPF) or ESI from your salary, choose Yes.

unemployedGraduate.title: Did you finish a degree or diploma and still have no job 6 months after passing?
unemployedGraduate.help: Self-employment and apprenticeship pay count as having work.

womanHeadOfFamily.title: Are you named as the head of the family on your ration card?
womanHeadOfFamily.help: Look for 'head of family' (yajamani) on the card.

familyFilesGst.title: Does your family file GST returns?
familyFilesGst.help: Usually only families that run a registered business.

familyPaysIncomeTax.title: Does anyone in your family pay income tax?
familyPaysIncomeTax.help: Some schemes are not for income tax payers. Choose "I don't know" if you are not sure.

selfPaysIncomeTax.title: Do you yourself pay income tax?
selfPaysIncomeTax.help: Some pension schemes are only for people who don't pay income tax.

familyGovtEmployee.title: Does anyone in your family work in government service or get a government pension?
familyGovtEmployee.help: Some schemes are not for families of government employees.

ownsPuccaHouse.title: Does anyone in your family own a pucca (permanent) house anywhere in India?
ownsPuccaHouse.help: A pucca house has permanent walls and a permanent roof.

bplHousehold.title: Is your family on the BPL (below poverty line) list?
bplHousehold.help: For example, if you have a BPL or Antyodaya (AAY) ration card. Choose "I don't know" if you are not sure.

hasDaughterUnder10.title: Do you have a daughter younger than 10 years?
hasDaughterUnder10.help: There is a special savings scheme for young daughters.

states.dh: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

describe.title: Tell us about yourself
describe.body: Write or speak a few lines in English, ಕನ್ನಡ or हिन्दी. For example:
describe.example: I am a 45-year-old farmer from Mandya with 2 acres of land. Our family income is about 1.5 lakh a year.
describe.label: Your situation
describe.voiceUnavailable: Voice typing doesn't work in this browser. Please use Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge, or type instead.
describe.understood: Here is what we understood. Please check:
describe.nothingFound: We couldn't pick up details from that. Try adding your age, your work and where you live — or answer step by step.
describe.aiNote: Read by AI. Please check before continuing.
describe.rulesNote: Read automatically from your words. Please check before continuing.
describe.privacyNote: Don't write your name, phone, Aadhaar or bank numbers.
describe.voiceDenied: Microphone access is blocked. Tap the lock icon next to the web address, allow the microphone, then try again.
describe.voiceNoMic: We couldn't find a working microphone. Check that one is connected and not used by another app.
describe.voiceNoSpeech: We didn't hear anything. Tap Speak and talk clearly, close to the microphone.
describe.voiceNetwork: Voice typing needs an internet connection and works best in Google Chrome. Please check your connection or type instead.
describe.voiceLanguage: This browser can't understand this language by voice yet. Try Google Chrome, or switch language at the top, or type instead.

results.title: My Schemes
results.subtitle: Based on your answers. Every rule is checked — nothing is guessed.
results.groupLikely: Probably yes — some answers are missing
results.emptyBody: Answer a few simple questions to see which schemes fit you.
results.noneBody: We are adding more schemes. You can also update your answers.
results.stateNote: We checked every central scheme for you. We don't have {state} government schemes yet — you can also search them on myScheme, the official national portal.

trust.explain: Rules checked against public sources. Please confirm on the official portal before applying.

deadline.unknown: Deadline not announced — check the official portal

scheme.allSchemesSubtitle: Central schemes for all of India, and state schemes, in Sahaay AI.

documents.time: Time taken varies by office — apply early.

roadmap.title: My Roadmap
roadmap.subtitle: Follow these steps in order. Mark documents as you get them.
roadmap.riskDocMissingSlow: Get this soon — office certificates can take time.
roadmap.riskDocApplyingSlow: In progress — follow up with the office.
roadmap.riskDocMissing: Quick to arrange, but don't forget it.
roadmap.riskUnknown: Answer this to be sure you qualify.
roadmap.noRisks: No blockers found. You are ready to apply!
roadmap.emptyBody: First, tell us about yourself so we can find your schemes.
roadmap.noSchemesTitle: No schemes to plan for yet
roadmap.noSchemesBody: None of our schemes match your answers right now. Try updating your answers.

settings.title: Profile & settings
settings.dataBody: Your answers and document checklist are saved only in this browser. Nothing is sent to a server.
settings.dataBodySignedIn: Your answers and document checklist are saved in this browser and in your account, so you can use them on any device.
settings.deleteConfirm: Delete all saved answers on this device? This cannot be undone.
settings.deleted: Your data has been deleted from this device.
settings.aboutBody: Sahaay AI helps you find government schemes you may qualify for. Eligibility is checked using fixed rules, never guessed by AI.

assistant.title: Sahaay Assistant
assistant.intro: Ask me about schemes, documents or next steps — in English, ಕನ್ನಡ or हिन्दी. You can also tell me about yourself and I'll find your schemes.
assistant.placeholder: Type your question or describe your situation…
assistant.error: Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again.
assistant.modeBasic: Answers come straight from our verified scheme data.
assistant.modeAi: AI answers use only our verified scheme data. Always confirm on the official portal.
assistant.sDocs: Which documents do I need first?
assistant.sSafe: Do I have to pay anyone to apply?
assistant.noProfile: I don't know about you yet. Tell me about yourself (your age, your work and where you live), or answer a few questions.
assistant.listIntro: Based on your answers, you can apply for {count} scheme(s):
assistant.likelyIntro: You may also qualify for these (some answers are missing):
assistant.noneMatch: No scheme matches your answers yet. You can update your answers, or check back later as we add more schemes.
assistant.whyIntro: {scheme} — here is how your answers match:
assistant.docsFirst: Documents to get first (needed for most of your schemes):
assistant.nextStep: Your next step: get your {doc}. Where: {where}
assistant.nextAllDone: You have all your documents. Now apply — start with {scheme} on {portal}.
assistant.safety: Applying for government schemes is free. Never pay an agent, and never share your OTP, PIN or bank password. Use only the official portals shown on each scheme.
assistant.deadline: We don't have a verified deadline for {scheme}. Please check {portal}.
assistant.fallback: I can help with: which schemes you can get, why you qualify, which documents you need, how to apply, and your next step. Try one of the suggestions below.
assistant.detected: Thanks! From what you wrote, I understood:
assistant.askNext: To find the right schemes for you, one quick question:
assistant.doneAsking: That's all I need. Here are the schemes for you:
assistant.typeAge: Type your age as a number below, or choose an option.
assistant.sExample: I'm a farmer and need support for my crops
assistant.resultsEmpty: No scheme matches yet. I'll keep looking as new schemes are added.

simple.title: Simple mode
simple.body: Bigger text and stronger colours — easier to read.

report.title: What is wrong on this page?
report.placeholder: For example: the rule changed, or a link doesn't work. Please don't include personal details.
report.sent: Thank you! Our team will check it against the official source.
report.error: Could not send right now. Please try again later.

help.title: Get help near you
help.body: These official centres help with certificates and applications. Government services are free or have small official fees — never pay agents.
help.revenueOfficeBody: Caste, income, residence and other certificates from the revenue department. Many states also offer these online.
help.kaCentres: In Karnataka: Nadakacheri, Grama One, Karnataka One
help.kaCentresBody: Karnataka certificates and Seva Sindhu applications like Gruha Lakshmi and Yuva Nidhi.
help.cscBody: Central schemes such as PM-KISAN, PM Vishwakarma and pension schemes.
help.bankBody: Aadhaar linking for DBT, insurance (PMJJBY, PMSBY), Atal Pension and business loans.
help.mapNote: Map results come from Google Maps. Always check you are at a government office.

demo.title: Try an example person
demo.body: See Sahaay AI in action with a ready-made person. Their answers load in one click, and you can change them any time.
demo.note: This replaces the answers saved on this device. Continue?

alerts.title: Get alerts for new schemes
alerts.body: We'll email you when a new scheme matches your answers, or when a deadline is near.
alerts.consent: Yes, email me scheme alerts. I can turn them off any time.
alerts.consentRequired: Please tick the box to agree to email alerts.
alerts.sent: Almost done! Open the link we emailed you to switch on alerts.
alerts.privacy: We only use your email for these alerts. No passwords. You can delete your account any time.

account.title: Your account
account.body: Sign in to save your answers on all your devices and get alerts when a new scheme matches you.
account.sent: Check your email and open the link to sign in.
account.alertsLabel: Email me when a new scheme matches me
account.synced: Your answers are saved to your account.
account.deleteAccountConfirm: Permanently delete your account and all saved data? This cannot be undone.
account.notConfigured: Accounts are not available yet. Your answers are still saved on this device.
account.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
account.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
account.callbackFailed: This sign-in link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.
account.unavailable: Sign-in isn't available right now — we can't reach the account service. You can keep using Sahaay without signing in; your answers stay saved on this device.
account.rateLimited: Too many sign-in links were requested. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.empty: No notifications yet. We will tell you when a new scheme matches you.
notifications.new_match: New scheme you may qualify for: {scheme}
notifications.scheme_updated: A scheme you qualify for has changed: {scheme}
notifications.signIn: Sign in to get alerts when new schemes match you.
notifications.emailIntro: Hello! Here are your scheme updates:
notifications.emailFooter: You get these emails because alerts are on in your Sahaay AI profile. You can turn them off in Profile & settings. Applying for government schemes is free — never pay anyone or share your OTP.
